description_en: Retrieves the configuration parameter information of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的配置参数信息
name: DescribeParameters

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

CurrentValue.description_en: The current value of the configuration parameter

ForceRestartInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance must be restarted. Valid values:

true: The instance must be restarted.
false: The instance does not need to be restarted
ForceRestartInstance.description_zh:
是否需要重启实例。取值说明：

true：需要重启实例。
false：不需要重启实例

IsChangeableConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration parameter can be modified. Valid values:

true: The parameter can be modified.
false: The parameter cannot be modified
IsChangeableConfig.description_zh:
配置参数是否可修改。取值说明：

true：可修改。
false：不可修改

OptionalRange.description_en: The value range of the configuration parameter

ParameterDescription.description_en: The description of the configuration parameter
ParameterDescription.example: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement，A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the configuration parameter

ParameterValue.description_en: The default value of the configuration parameter
